description.text:
The Battle Party Set's reward packs were the prizes inside each box: one Battle King reward pack (对战王者奖赏包) and three Battle Master reward packs (对战大师奖赏包), each holding one random holo card. At Battle Party events, held at gyms and partner shops from 15 April 2023 with one box for eight players, each player drew one of the box's eight decks at random and played three rounds of Swiss; on their results one player became Battle King and three became Battle Masters, and took the packs.

Our list puts the cards of both packs together. Holo Pokémon-GX, shiny Gible, Gabite and Garchomp and holo basic Energy are numbered to 24; full-art Mewtwo-GX and Supporters, full-art basic Energy, rainbow GX cards and a special Mewtwo-GX are numbered past it, up to 48.

The events drew far more players than there were places. Within days Pokémon moved sign-ups to a random draw, brought in identity checks for the 64-player Battle Party King tournaments (王者争夺赛) after players entered with several accounts, and suspended eight shops' official gym status for breaking the event rules. It said it had stock for 50,000 eight-player events, 400,000 places, and that 300 King tournaments with 19,200 places would run between 15 April and 14 July 2023.
